title: frontend / session.control_requested (v1) data payload
description: An operator race-control action to start or end a session. Published to the 'frontend.events' exchange with routing key 'session.control_requested'; consumed by Timing, which turns it into the ACTUAL session.started / session.ended. (ADR-0010.)

requestId.description: Correlates the control action with Timing's resulting event.

sessionId.description: The session to start or end.

action.description: Race-control action. Starting an already-started or ending a never-started session is handled gracefully (Round 14).

adminActor.description: The operator/admin account that issued the action (for audit attribution).

at.description: When the operator issued the action (RFC3339 UTC).
